spoken_first_2s: हाय गाइज वेलकम टू माय मिनी सड़ी हॉल मित

notes.hook: 'Hi guys, welcome to my mini saree haul', then the sale and 'under 999'
notes.what_goes_wrong: It opens with 'hi guys welcome'; the sale plus '4 sarees under ₹999' should be the first line. It worked on sale-week demand, not because of the opener.
notes.reusable_pattern: A sale-week haul: name the sale and the price ceiling, then one line per item on who it suits (farewell, office, teacher).
